summary: Expose composite tailnet and Devnet edge admission for deployment-owned web overlays.

compatibility.detail: Opt-in helper reuses tailnet login and exact Origin admission while preserving a supplied legacy edge policy. Serve-shaped requests cannot fall through to the login-free edge policy.

downtime.detail: This export does not activate or restart any deployment.

manual.detail: The deployment owner must wire edgeOrTailnetAdmission into the private overlay and configure the published origin plus nonempty tailnet login allowlist. Keep proxy headers intact and the app listener loopback-only.

recovery.detail: Omit the published origin to return the exact existing edge admission policy; roll back deployment-owned wiring independently.
